$comment: One edit to seeded-correct-run: R-001, the unencrypted-queue risk, is covered at Component instead of
It is in the corpus because a risk that reaches the coverage plan at a level that cannot establish it is
the failure a plain count of linked risks would miss. The fixture admits Unit, Integration and E2E for
this risk, because what is on disk is settled by opening the file the queue writes; a component test of a
UI surface establishes nothing about it.
derivation: Everything seeded-correct-run derives holds except one coverage check.
Coverage: R-001 is linked from exactly one row and that row's level is Component, which is not in the
admitted set Unit, Integration, E2E. The check fails with the levels it did find, so satisfied falls to 4
over an evaluated count of 5.
The risk link still resolves, because Component is a level and R-001 is still a declared id, so links stay
5 of 5. Grounding stays 5 of 5 for the same reason as before.
Ordering is unchanged at 9 of 9. R-001 is still linked from a P0 row, so its priority is still P0 and every
pair it takes part in still holds.
WHAT MOVED AT SCORER VERSION 5
`banded` is now `rows` on every case, because a row under a heading that declares no score range is a
band failure rather than an exemption. `cleanControl` is `ceiling` and both sets declare one, so the
seeded corpus is bounded too. `grounding` carries `topSeverityMissed`, the count of the set's
lowest-ranked risks that went unreported. Material risks are assigned by maximum matching rather than
first-come, and every row is tested against the exclusions whether or not it matched a material risk.
AT SCORER VERSION 6
`ordering` carries `flattened`, which is true when every material risk that reached a priority reached
the same one. A plan like that satisfies every pairwise constraint without ordering anything, so the
metric reports unmeasurable rather than a perfect score.
AT SCORER VERSION 7
`unscoredRiskTables` records every table that names risks with an `R-NNN` id and states no score. Such a
table cannot be scored and used to be skipped without a word, so a register split across a scored table
and an unscored one lost its second half silently. The threshold on the count is zero.

failures.reason: no linked row uses an admitted level
